title: Table of every concentric row (and of the controls)
status: final (rc2 runs) for g <= 200 dx; the rows at g = 400 dx are not reached
caption: Every micropolar row between concentric cylinders (R1 = 4 g, R2 = 5 g, U = Omega R1, w = 0 on both walls, Ma = 0.02, end time 2 g^2 / nu_inf, last quarter averaged). D_SPH: the potential-vortex constant of the velocity fit over that of the run's Newtonian control, minus one; D_exact and D_rule (the rule in its slip form) with the hydrodynamic radii of the control; noise floor: spread of the control's beta over three lattices, over D_exact (the row at g = 400 dx has one lattice and carries the floor of g = 200 dx; its step is the only one set by the viscous limit); steady: relative change of the fitted constant between the last two eighths of the run; drifts: change of the fluid's mean density (over rho0) and mean pressure (over rho U^2) between the last two eighths ('-' where the run did not record them). The second table lists the controls. 19 rows; D_SPH / D_exact by l / dx: l = 5 dx: 1.0241 to 1.0322; l = 10 dx: 1.0052 to 1.0152; l = 20 dx: 1.0015 to 1.0015; l = 25 dx: 1.0009 to 1.0015; l = 50 dx: 1.0004 to 1.0012. Largest departure: `g200_k3_m20`, 1.0322.
